description: This Java source file defines the DevOpsCommandsActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for handling DevOps commands within a distributed microservices environment. It manages subscription to command topics, processing commands received via cluster pub/sub, and coordinating responses, including special handling for piggyback commands and logger configuration retrieval.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandsActor
classes.description: Main actor for processing DevOps commands, handling cluster pub/sub subscriptions, command forwarding, and response aggregation.

classes.name: PubSubSubscriberActor
classes.description: Inner actor responsible for subscribing to specific pub/sub topics within the cluster.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandViaPubSub
classes.description: Wrapper class for DevOps commands that are sent via pub/sub mechanisms.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandResponseCorrelationActor
classes.description: Child actor that collects responses for a specific DevOps command, aggregates results, and forwards the aggregated response.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for DevOpsCommandsActor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for DevOpsCommandsActor, including command processing and fallback.

methods.name: handleInitialDevOpsCommand
methods.description: Handles DevOps commands issued via HTTP, publishing them to the cluster pub/sub or directly as piggyback commands.

methods.name: handleDevOpsCommandViaPubSub
methods.description: Processes commands received from pub/sub and delegates to specific handlers based on command type.

methods.name: handleChangeLogLevel
methods.description: Handles ChangeLogLevel commands by updating the logger configuration.

methods.name: handleRetrieveLoggerConfig
methods.description: Handles RetrieveLoggerConfig commands by retrieving logger configurations.

methods.name: handleExecutePiggyBack
methods.description: Handles execution of piggyback commands, forwarding them to specified actor selections.

methods.name: deserializePiggybackCommand
methods.description: Parses piggyback command JSON into a Jsonifiable object, using the mapping strategy.

methods.name: getErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates error responses for DevOps commands.
